scope: Joint outgoing radius-two side and disk response for a sharp steady geometry, spatially varying background coherent carrier, and diffuse planar reversible front calibrated at the disk mean. The interior order is frozen in the acoustic volume. The steady transonic edge, its fully spatially responding order and physical mean exit force are unresolved.

method_limitations.time_dependence: exp(-i omega t); Q=Re(omega)/(-2 Im(omega)); fractional free energy loss = 1-exp(4 pi Im(omega)/Re(omega)).
method_limitations.standards: 7.20050% and 0.18564% are driven source costs in a homogeneous receiver. Both lack radiation into the feeding brane.
method_limitations.force: Negative real pole-frequency slope and separate reactive derivative proxy. Neither solves for the second-order DC force and free exit in a nonuniform transonic diffuse front.
method_limitations.moving_section: Per-bin lab and comoving currents on the reference disk. Section motion also samples the base area and axial gradients. At the unresolved sharp rim the one-sided reconstructions differ.
method_limitations.excluded: Original coarse nine-cell pilot used a different zero-frequency subtraction and is excluded from the comparison. Initial import failures and pre-admission absences produced no physical readings. Seven completed primary cases were adopted and the missing cases ran in fresh directories.

inputs: mean-front centered poles at acoustic meshes 12, 16 and 22

independent_review: The radius-2 breathing mode fails the sub-percent radiation gate with the coherent curved carrier and the mean-current terminal law. The physical loss at the spatially responding rim remains open.
